position_source: fresh signed PB0-PC0 only; raw channels are diagnostics

host_association.limitation: Host receipt is not sensor capture time. Interior windows, clean continuous transport and observed PWM support settled association; a constant unmeasured USB latency is not independently calibrated.

rotation_plane.angle_measurand: Rotation of the observed gravity vector in sensor coordinates, relative to the recorded1420reference
rotation_plane.sign_convention: Right-hand gravity-vector rotation about the fitted normal, whose largest sensor-axis component is positive. Mechanical basket orientation about the corresponding fixed hinge changes with opposite sign; physical airframe tilt sign is not assigned.
rotation_plane.interpretation: Conditional relative angles from actual settled gravity vectors; cross-axis calibration and physical pivot-axis/vertical alignment are not independently proven.

provenance.limitation: FC observations are decoded CSV plus guarded run reports; raw MSP wire frames were not preserved. Hashes establish artifact identity, not independent physical truth.

interpretation: Settled relative gravity-vector observations only; gravity rotation in sensor coordinates has the opposite sign to sensor orientation about a corresponding fixed hinge. A small center arc cannot identify that plane reliably; XY results remain diagnostic when plane_not_identified. No angle is inferred from PWM, no dynamic timing or absolute vertical zero is claimed, and no device output is written.
